negative_control.conclusion: Distinct surface genera, isomorphic dual multigraphs: identical scalar zero-field Ising thermodynamics at every beta.

finite_limit_conclusions.including_zero: For every fixed connected finite graph, d_eff(t) tends to zero as t tends to zero and as t tends to infinity.
finite_limit_conclusions.excluding_zero: d_eff_primed(t) tends to zero as t tends to zero and grows as 2 lambda_gap t at large t; this is exponential decay, not a dimension.
finite_limit_conclusions.spectral_zeta: The finite sum over positive eigenvalues is entire in s and has no pole from which to infer a continuum spectral dimension.
finite_limit_conclusions.Ising: Z is a finite sum of positive exponentials for real beta; log Z is real analytic. No thermodynamic critical exponent is determined by this one finite graph.
finite_limit_conclusions.next_gate: Register a growing/refining graph family, metric and coupling scaling, and finite-size/continuum window before estimating universal critical behavior.
